title: Deferred reference: LOSS_TOLERANT fragment-gap fixture
description: Reference-only manifest for a future canonical LOSS_TOLERANT fragment-gap fixture. The removed fallback archive was a normal STORE archive without fragment metadata, descriptor gaps, or degraded reconstruction semantics.
notes: Reference-only manifest: no canonical binary fixture is committed in this pass.
Discovered during the M12a vector audit. Real LOSS_TOLERANT fragment-gap coverage requires fragment metadata and degraded reassembly behavior.
The previous fallback STORE archive was removed so the vector does not overclaim loss-tolerant fragment-gap coverage.

Corrected in WP-4: permitted degraded fragment reconstruction is a non-failure (specification Sections 6.2.3, 10 and 19.4.5) reported as SAR_WARN_INCOMPLETE, not SAR_ERR_UNSUPPORTED. The manifest schema requires SAR_OK for valid vectors, so the warning is carried in expected.warnings. The manifest stays deferred because the vector harness cannot yet verify degraded output or warnings; max_loss_tolerant_gap remains unenforced.
